NOTE: Dan Tom is the only TRUSTED source (+56% ROI) but his picks live behind a Substack paywall, so only his TWEETS are gradeable (he remains in the roster as an X source). Do not re-add these as YouTube sources without checking they actually post prediction videos.

_qualityPruned_2026_07_15: Cut after a title-substance review: MMA Lock of the Night (@mmalotn), Matty Betss (@mattybetss), Bedtime MMA (@bedtimemma), TonyHasDiedMMA (@tonyhasdiedmma), mmadbm (@mmadbm), In The Green DFS (@inthegreendfs), Picks Nation (@picksnation), Dribbl Sport (@dribblsport). Reasons: multi-sport betting, DFS/player-props (not who-wins), comedy/tier-lists, casual hot-takes, news-dominated, or livestream/lock-spam. High title-yield but low fight-IQ. The beat-the-line grader remains the definitive filter for the rest.
